subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young East Asian woman in <Picture 1>, about 22 years old, with dark brown-black hair in a high messy bun with fine baby hairs at the hairline and two loose strands per temple, straight slightly thick dark-brown brows, narrow elongated inner-double eyelids with dark brown irises, a narrow straight nose with a small round tip, full matte dusty-rose lips, warm light-medium beige skin with visible pores and faint cheek redness, a lean athletic build with slim arms and a narrow waist, and a neutral bare-faced expression.
<Subject 2> is the environment in <Picture 2>: an indoor diving hall with large pale-grey tiled walls, a deep navy and brick-red painted band, a dark steel truss roof, a white steel diving platform with a teal-green top and black hydraulic supports, and a turquoise pool reflecting the structure, lit by cool light from high windows.
<Audio 1> is the voice-timbre reference for <Subject 1> (S1), containing a spoken Mandarin vocal layer.

summary:
[reference generation + audio reference] The target video is a 10-second vertical 9:16 single-shot clip in which <Subject 1> speaks directly to camera inside <Subject 2>; <Audio 1> supplies her voice timbre. This clip is segment 2 of 4 of the short video.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - her high bun with the loose temple strands, her facial features, warm skin texture, and the exact outfit, colourway and footwear shown in <Picture 1> are retained.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the described layout, materials, props and light direction are retained as the background of the shot.
<Audio 1>: reference - its vocal timbre guides the dialogue delivery of <Subject 1> without copying the original signal.

detailed_description:
The target video is a 10-second vertical 9:16 single continuous shot in a realistic, cinematic style with shallow depth of field and fine film grain. The camera is the viewer sitting across from her at her eye level, and she looks straight into the lens for the entire shot without ever looking away.
[Shot 1] A medium shot of <Subject 1>, framed from the waist up. She wears a mint-green and pink abstract leaf-print one-piece swimsuit with a halter neckline, mint piping at the collar and armholes, a small bow on the left chest, high-cut legs, barefoot, her hair in a high bun. Her knees bend slightly and she rocks her weight from one hip to the other, then tilts her head and shrugs on the next beat; on the last phrase her knees give a small dip and her shoulders sink as if the effort has just failed her, and she catches her balance with a tiny sway before stopping. <Subject 2> stays softly defocused behind her at all times. The camera eases back slightly and settles, keeping her eyes on the horizontal third line. The cool side light rims her shoulder and the back of her neck while a soft, even patch of skylight keeps her face readable. <Subject 1> (S1) speaks in the clear, conversational young female voice timbre referenced from <Audio 1>, <d>[Chinese] 你先是每天走一万步，接着加了跳舞，结果上楼还是腿软。</d> The line starts about a second and a half into the clip and lands with roughly a second of held expression before the ten seconds run out. Her weight shifts audibly on the wet tile, and a short exhale lands on the last phrase.

overall_soundscape:
Hall reverb continues with a deeper tail as she turns her shoulder toward the pool, plus a soft scuff of bare feet shifting on tile and two audible breaths.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A
